section1.title: 1. General Rental Terms
section1.content: The renter must be at least 18 years old and hold a valid driver's license for the respective vehicle category. The vehicle is delivered in excellent condition and must be returned in the same state.

section2.title: 2. Insurance & Damages
section2.content: Third-party insurance is included in the rental price. In case of damage caused by the renter, they are responsible for the repair costs.

section3.title: 3. Cancellation Policy
section3.content: Cancellations are accepted free of charge up to 48 hours before the scheduled pick-up time. For late cancellations or no-shows, a fee may apply.

section4.title: 4. Vehicle Usage
section4.content: Driving off-road or on the beach is strictly prohibited. The vehicle is intended solely for transportation within the island's road network.
